cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Will you give me your first turn, even if it costs you the match? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You said you were on my side. This side has a cost.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then lend the emotion a turn so I can see it.

mechanism: A negotiates a smaller ceded first turn as a visible loyalty cost, keeping B emotionally supportive but requiring a disadvantage in play.
confusable: Unlike accepting verbal encouragement, A asks B to sacrifice an actual competitive opportunity for A.
comparison: A turn concession narrowed within a match differs from a prize recipient missing a ceremony for a friend show.
seedUse: D203-a first turn and emotional support; S02-a narrows the sacrifice while retaining its competitive cost.
